* Upgrade your plan on the provider's own dashboard.
> **MCPJam account limit vs. provider throttle** — If the session pane shows a billing or credit message instead of this card, the
limit is on your MCPJam account, not your provider key. Adding credits or switching to BYOK resolves that case; the steps above d
o not apply.
### Frontier model sign-in required
`provider/guest_model_not_allowed`
A frontier model was selected but the request requires a signed-in account.
* A sign-in prompt appears automatically. Click **Sign in** to authenticate and get access to frontier models.
* Click **Not now** to dismiss and continue with a standard model. Your credit balance is not affected.
### Out of MCPJam credits
`provider/mcpjam_limit_daily` · `provider/mcpjam_limit_monthly` · `provider/mcpjam_limit` · `provider/mcpjam_limit_insufficient`
MCPJam refused the call before it reached a provider. For the daily, monthly,
and general codes, the account's own allowance is spent.
`provider/mcpjam_limit_insufficient` means the balance is not empty but is below
**Next steps**
* **Free plan (owner)** — The limit dialog shows **Compare plans** to upgrade, and **Learn more about BYOK** to understand how pro
vider keys and MCPJam credits work separately.
* **Free plan (admin or member)** — The dialog shows a **Request upgrade** link to email an organization owner.
* **Paid plan (owner or admin)** — The dialog shows **Buy credits** to add shared credits to your organization.
* **Paid plan (member)** — The dialog shows a **Request credits** link to email an organization owner.
* Add your own API key under **Settings → LLM Providers** for chat (BYOK does not cover Swarm, Evals, or other MCPJam-billed featu
res).
* If your organization uses its own keys for all AI features, model tokens are billed by its providers instead; see [Organization
AI key policy](#organization-ai-key-policy).
**Swarm and Eval runs**
When credits run out during a Swarm or Eval run, blocked work stops and you receive one credit-exhaustion prompt per run, or one p
er swarm when a swarm launches several runs at once. Completed results are preserved. Buying credits does not automatically restar
t the run — start a new run once credits are available.
> [!WARNING]
> Bring-your-own-key covers chat. Swarm persona generation and persona-driver
> turns are billed to MCPJam and have no personal BYOK path, so adding a key
> does not lift this limit for a swarm. An organization that uses its own keys
- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and approv
e the actions that spend credits
- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-h
osted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization
's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Th
e ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billi
ng window, and how much of it has been spent.
- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs
to — the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one o
rganization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.
- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credit
s are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` r
